newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel prices climb with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel prices climb with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices rose moderately with NYMEX May futures on Thursday, players said, with differentials little changed in lackluster trade.
U.S. Gulf aviation-quality 54-grade was traded for 0.75 cent over the print, with offers at about 1.0 cent late in the day, players said.
New York Harbor material was talked about 3.60 cents over the print in similarly quiet activity, traders said.
May NYMEX heating oil, the basis for spot jet fuel values, settled 0.74 cent higher at 53.26 cents a gallon.
